    low = np.array([-6.28, -2.24, -6.28, -2.57, -6.28, -2.09, -6.28])

left = m.body('robot_left_pad').id

qa = np.arange(90, 97)

    for _ in range(200):
        err = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float) - d.xpos[base][:2]
        a = np.zeros(11)
        a[:2] = np.clip(err, -0.1, 0.1)
        s.step(a)
        if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.015:
            break


def solve_midpoint(target):
    saved = d.qpos[qa].copy()
    low = np.array([-6.28, -2.24, -6.28, -2.57, -6.28, -2.09, -6.28])
    high = -low
    for _ in range(800):
        mid = (d.xpos[left] + d.xpos[right]) / 2
        err = target - mid
        if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.003:
            break
        jp1 = np.zeros((3, m.nv)); jr1 = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        jp2 = np.zeros((3, m.nv)); jr2 = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        mujoco.mj_jacBody(m, d, jp1, jr1, left)
        mujoco.mj_jacBody(m, d, jp2, jr2, right)
        jac = ((jp1 + jp2) / 2)[:, adr]
        dq = jac.T @ np.linalg.solve(jac @ jac.T + 0.003 * np.eye(3), err)
        d.qpos[qa] = np.clip(d.qpos[qa] + np.clip(dq, -0.06, 0.06), low, high)

        a[3:10] = np.clip(dq, -0.1, 0.1)
        s.step(a)
